## 席位核对
**ACCEPT** · seat `domain:ui#1` · head `f4877f89` · 2026-10-30T14:46Z

席位意见：一次保存同时违反多条校验规则时，表单横幅和提示现在一条规则一行；指向表单上可见字段的规则仍标在该字段下，横幅只说其余的。服务端返回的拒收信封不变，控制台只是读取它本来就带的每条规则一项。新增一个公开辅助函数 `unmarkedRefusalLines`，已按扩面申报 `Clause-②: yes (widening)`。

1. **Shape:** `Fixes #28053`, draft, base `main`; 9 files, +437/−28: `ui/packages/react/src/utils/error-message.ts` (`fieldEntries` extracted from `extractFieldErrors`, new `unmarkedRefusalLines(err, isShownInline)`; `null` when there is no entry list or an unshown entry lacks a message, so the caller keeps the envelope text), its export in `ui/packages/react/src/index.ts`, the submit catches of `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` and `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` (one list item per unmarked entry; a single line stays a string), tests beside each, root changeset `28053-one-line-per-failed-rule.md` (react, components, console patch).
2. **Premise measured:** the dev drove `POST /api/v1/data/:object` over a real engine on `6410029d`: one `fields[]` entry per failed rule, so this is console-only and not a Seam (triage `6520981886` direction). Seat read of the diff: `declaredUserMessage` / `delegationScopeMessage` / the permission line keep their precedence over the new lines; a refusal without `fields[]` (unique violation, plain 500) is unchanged.
3. **Declaration corrected:** the claim's `Clause-②: no` was the seat's error; amended on #28053, and the changeset and PR body now read `Clause-②: yes (widening: @object-ui/react gains the public export unmarkedRefusalLines; no accept set moves)`. Owed review = this seat's own record at the default tier (no `packages/spec` path, no accept set moves).
4. **Gates / check-runs:** on head `f4877f89`: 46 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure (Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Build & E2E UI, Test UI, Check Changeset all success); `mergeable_state` clean. The three reds on `767d45bb` were roll-ups of jobs cancelled by the push to `f4877f89`. Dev's local run: 34/34 derived gates exit 0, react/components/console type-check exit 0, 67 targeted tests green, ablation red then restored; relay writes 2, MCP writes 0.
5. **Out of scope:** FormPage still shows `Submit failed (STATUS): ` plus the raw response body for a refusal with no `fields[]` list (PR Acceptance notes); pre-existing and untouched here, noted, not filed. #27999's files untouched.
6. **Landing:** `check-governed-merges --branch` NOT governed, 465 changed lines ≤ 3000. The same seat session dispatched and reviewed this PR. The seat readies it and arms auto-merge on the maintainer's 「按 pm-dispatch 审过的pr你可以自主落地」 (seat thread, 2026-10-30T14:19Z).
